infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cyrelle uses the camera for posts, stories, reels, live video, and identity verification selfies.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cyrelle uses the microphone for reels, live audio, and optional emergency voice messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cyrelle uses your photo library when you choose images or videos to post.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cyrelle uses your location only when you choose to share it in an emergency or attach a place to a post.
